ambiguities: The narrator's remark that he followed the Boer War to see Saint-Loup's military principles 'se démentir' (refuted) could be read as a mild discredit of Saint-Loup's military judgment, but it occurs inside an essayistic digression about the narrator's own courage rather than a staged interaction, so it was not scored as a distinct local event.

Mme de Villeparisis is mentioned only as the circumstantial cause of Charlus's unusual visiting hour (her indisposition); this is a causal explanation, not an evaluative event about her, so no status effect was recorded.
The Montjouvain memory names Mlle Vinteuil, not M. Vinteuil; the fleeting recollection carries no local evaluative content for either, so it was left unscored.
